description: Long-form feature rows that alternate image-left / image-right. Best for 2-4 high-priority features that each deserve their own screenshot and a paragraph of explanation. Skip when there's no real imagery — empty windows look hollow.

description.hint: 1 sentence intro framing why these features matter.
